meta.cluster_rule: tiles flagged top 5% in at least 90% of runs, joined by 8-neighbour adjacency on the v1 grid, wrapping at the date line
meta.flag_source: robust column of mc_summary.parquet, base profile of each target
meta.label: Groups of neighbouring tiles that v1 flagged on terrain. Candidates not in our reference list, unreviewed.
limits: Regions are groups of neighbouring tiles that v1 flagged on Earth terrain. They are candidates not in our reference list and none has been reviewed.
A region is not a site. It says where v1's terrain score is high, not that the place is a good analog for lunar or Martian work.
The Moon score is effectively terrain only. Gravity, air, dust and radiation are not scored.
Regions within the drop distance of any reference site are left out, so the list is not a full map of high scores.
Small groups are left out. The minimum size is a choice made in this build, not a v1 setting.
No place names are shown: no gazetteer has been chosen yet.
Regions appear only where v1 had terrain data and the tile passed the gates.
India counts use the Natural Earth outline from v1, which is not an official map.
Regions with fewer than 100 tiles are left out.
Regions within 100 km of any reference site are left out.

regions.caveat: Flagged by v1 on Earth terrain only. Not reviewed. Not checked against independent data. v1 failed its negative controls, so a flag here is a reason to look, not a finding.
